author: The Current
description:
Bon Iver's Justin Vernon returns to the stage as Bon Dylan on Friday, July 24, at the 2026 Eaux Claires Festival in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. Here's a flashback to his 2017 performance of "Holocene" at the Rock the Garden Festival in Minneapolis.

For coverage of the 2026 Eaux Claires Festival check out thecurrent.org/eauxclaires, and follow us on Instagram.

#BonIver @boniver #TheCurrent #Holocene
title: Flashback: Bon Iver's stuns with "Holocene" live #BonIver
